prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: layered PSD background plate
Primary request: rebuild the clean background scene from the reference poster as an empty stage for later compositing
Input images: Image 1 is the full poster layout and style authority
Scene/backdrop: bright blue sky, fluffy white clouds, dreamy playground park horizon, sunlit grass lawn with tiny flowers, soft depth of field
Style/medium: premium 3D toy-like illustration, glossy but warm, cheerful children poster quality
Composition/framing: match the same vertical poster camera angle, horizon placement, cloud distribution, and overall depth as the reference
Lighting/mood: sunny, happy, airy, polished
Color palette: sky blue, soft white, spring green, candy pastel accents in the far distance only
Constraints: remove all foreground overlays and characters; no logo; no text; no ribbons; no mascot; no balloons; no slide in the foreground; no pinwheel; no blocks; no tent; no paper airplane; no doodle lines; no confetti; no sun icon graphic; keep the scene clean and empty for compositing
Avoid: watermark, extra objects, frame, border, collage, shadows from removed objects

Reference images (by role — obey each role strictly, do not swap them):
- Image 1: layout reference — follow placement, framing, crop, whitespace, and camera arrangement faithfully, without borrowing foreign product identity
- Image 2: artistic tone reference — imitate only style, palette and mood, do NOT copy its content/objects
